description: This PHP class defines a VacancySummaryModel for the OrangeHRM recruitment module, representing a summarized view of a job vacancy with properties like id, name, status, and publication status. It implements serialization and normalization features through traits and interfaces, likely to facilitate API responses.

classes.name: VacancySummaryModel
classes.description: A model representing a summarized view of a vacancy with serialization capabilities in the recruitment API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the VacancySummaryModel with a Vacancy entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
